research_intro: Focus on computational modeling, artificial intelligence, and digital twin development for cardiovascular and respiratory health. I develop data-driven frameworks that integrate deep learning with physics-based modeling to automate anatomical reconstruction, simulation, and translational clinical tools. My work bridges biomedical engineering, scientific computing, and AI to advance precision medicine.

positions.unit: Predictive Modeling in Medicine Lab, Center for Computational Medicine, Oden Institute for Computational Engineering and Sciences
positions.summary: Research focuses on integrating artificial intelligence, medical imaging, and computational modeling to study physiology and advance medicine. Expanding research to explore clinically driven applications of AI and simulation, with the goal of developing digital tools that bridge computational models and patient care.

Developed deep learning–based methods for automatic vascular model construction and trajectory-oriented vessel tracking in medical imaging. Integrated physics-based modeling and machine learning to enable patient-specific cardiovascular simulations.
highlights: Developed SeqSeg: a deep learning framework for automatic vascular segmentation and model construction
Created MeshGrow: an automated pipeline for unified cardiac and vascular mesh generation
Contributed to SimVascular open-source cardiovascular modeling software
Mentored undergraduate and MEng teams in medical image analysis projects

positions.summary: Worked on material property analysis for medical biomaterials.
highlights: Collaborated on R&D for regenerative medical materials.

positions.summary: Developed computational models for new lung experimental technologies.

software: SeqSeg — Deep learning–based framework for automated vascular segmentation and model construction from CT and MR images. Includes preprocessing pipeline, vessel segment extraction method, and publicly released pretrained model weights. github.com/numisveinsson/SeqSeg

MeshGrow — Integrated framework for unified cardiac and vascular mesh construction from medical images, enabling automatic generation of anatomically consistent, simulation-ready 3D cardiovascular models. github.com/numisveinsson/MeshGrow
LinFlo-Net — Deep learning framework for cardiac segmentation and modeling. github.com/ArjunNarayanan/LinFlo-Net

SimVascular — Open-source cardiovascular modeling and simulation software. Contributed to feature development and testing in collaboration with the Marsden Lab at Stanford University. simvascular.github.io

MIROS (Medical Image to Reduced Order Simulation) — Toolkit for linking patient-specific medical imaging data to reduced-order hemodynamic simulations, facilitating efficient cardiovascular modeling and parameter estimation. github.com/BryannGan/MIROS

Vascular Model Repository — Collaborative online platform for sharing, visualizing, and comparing vascular geometries and simulation data; developed in partnership with the Marsden Lab to promote open science in cardiovascular modeling. vascularmodel.com
SlicerSeqSeg — 3D Slicer extension for automated vascular segmentation using SeqSeg. github.com/numisveinsson/SlicerSeqSeg
SlicerLinFloNet — 3D Slicer extension for vascular segmentation and modeling with LinFlo-Net. github.com/numisveinsson/SlicerLinFloNet
